KNOWLEDGE MANAGER

Keep useful answers current.

Manage approved documents and refresh your website information. Only upload information that may be shared with website visitors. Do not upload participant records.

Approved documents

PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown. Maximum 5 MB per file. Text-based PDFs are supported; scanned files need OCR first. Review imported documents at least every 120 days.

Refresh the provider website

Import the configured homepage, services and contact page. The configured contact details and registration status remain authoritative. Imported text is treated as source material, never as instructions.

Official NDIS guidance

The shared guidance is reviewed separately from each provider’s information. Update data/ndis.json after checking the current official sources. Guidance over 120 days old is excluded from server answers until reviewed.
